description: The identity office says my date of birth differs across two official documents and will not renew my card.
My employer has not paid my salary, and a shop also refuses a refund for a broken kettle. I want help with both problems.
The shop sent a dining table with two chairs missing. They say I must pay again to receive the chairs included in my order.
The matter has become difficult and I need help understanding it.
I guaranteed a loan for a friend who has stopped paying. The creditor is asking me to settle the outstanding balance.
The SACCO statement still lists a loan balance after my final payment. I want the repayment records checked.
The owner of my rented flat refuses to fix a sewage leak and says I must leave if I complain again.
My birth certificate has the wrong spelling of my surname and I need information on correcting the record.
A retailer will not replace a faulty freezer and a collection agency is pursuing an unrelated loan. Both disputes need attention.
My lender is chasing a debt I dispute, and I am also challenging a dismissal from my job. I want both matters considered.
My supervisor keeps mocking my disability during work meetings. My written workplace complaint has not been addressed.
My employer has refused to provide a certificate of service after my final day at work.
A supermarket till charged me for five bags of flour when I only bought three. The branch will not correct the bill.
I returned an unopened cooker within the return period advertised by the retailer. The shop is keeping both the cooker and my payment.
I cannot meet the next repayment on my loan and want to ask the lender about a payment arrangement.
Someone used my identity to open a loan account. A lender is now sending me demands for repayment.
I returned from approved maternity leave and the manager said my employment had ended without giving me a letter.
The university entered the wrong examination grade and is preventing me from registering for the next semester.
I lent a neighbour cash to pay hospital expenses. Our written repayment date has passed and she will not return the money.
A neighbour has fenced across the footpath used to reach our home and refuses to open the gate.
I accepted a written settlement offer for an old debt and paid the amount. The collector is still demanding the original full balance.
A collection agency is demanding a debt that belongs to somebody with a similar name. I have never borrowed from that lender.
A dry-cleaning business burned my coat during cleaning and refuses to discuss compensation for the damage.
My employer stopped scheduling me for work after I joined a trade union. I want information about this workplace dispute.
The school employing me changed my working hours and reduced my salary without discussing my employment contract.
The company transferred me to a lower-paid position after I reported harassment by a supervisor to human resources.
I was dismissed from my shop assistant job after an accusation about missing stock. I was not allowed to respond at the disciplinary meeting.
My brother and I disagree over who should administer the estate left by our mother.
I bought a rechargeable torch that does not charge. The seller will not honour the warranty printed on the receipt.
I have an unpaid wages dispute and a separate argument with relatives about an inheritance. I need information on both.
The boundary shown on our survey map differs from the fence put up by the owner of the next plot.
The lodge where I work has not paid my wages for six weeks. I have continued reporting for all my assigned shifts.
The mobile loan app received my instalment but has added a late fee as if I paid nothing.
I have an issue about some payments and a person I know.
My employer ended my employment after I asked why my overtime was missing from the payslip.
A friend will not repay a private loan and my landlord is also threatening eviction. Neither issue is more important to me.
A seller delivered damaged furniture, and my former partner and I also disagree about child custody. I need help with both.
Our savings group lent me money and has not credited two repayments made through M-Pesa.
I ordered a tank through a seller online and paid for delivery to Embu. No tank arrived and the seller is ignoring my refund request.
I paid for a new water pump at a hardware store in Kitui. The box contained a used pump and the trader will not exchange it.
My prepaid television provider deducted a sports package fee that I did not authorise. Customer care will not reverse it.
The bank and I disagree about the interest on my personal loan. Its statement uses a higher rate than the agreement.
Two relatives have submitted different papers claiming the right to manage our grandfather’s property after his death.
The bakery delivered the wrong cake for my event and rejected my complaint about the order I paid for.
I worked night shifts at a warehouse but the employer has not paid for the extra hours recorded on the attendance sheet.
The bus operator cancelled my trip after I bought a ticket. They have refused to refund the ticket price.
A former classmate signed an acknowledgement for money I lent him. He has moved away without repaying the debt.
The county office rejected a building permit application and has not explained how I can challenge the decision.
Please point me towards someone who can help with my situation.
The school will not release my daughter’s transfer documents after I requested that she change schools.
My former partner and I cannot agree on arrangements for our child during the school holidays.
My uncle borrowed money from me and agreed to repay in four instalments. He paid one and now denies owing the rest.
They keep telling me different things. I do not know where to begin.
The employer says I cannot take the annual leave I earned while working at the factory.
A decorator took a deposit to paint our house but never arrived. I asked for the payment back and they stopped replying.
Something happened a while ago and I need to know what I should do.
The clinic sold me a pair of spectacles with the wrong lenses. I am complaining as a customer about the product I purchased.
There is a problem with an agreement but I cannot explain it yet.
My employer deducts a uniform fee from my salary every month although the employment agreement lists it as a once-only charge.
The landlord changed the padlock on the room I rent while my tenancy agreement was still running.
